hero.lead: Send a photo of your product. Jaarle creates your poster, your story and your sales copy — ready for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp.
hero.proof: Already used by merchants in Dakar, Thiès and Touba

how.title: Three steps. Zero design skills.
how.desc: No Photoshop, no designer needed. Jaarle handles everything, from visual to copy.
how.s1d: A photo taken with your phone is enough. Add the product name and price, or just talk to Jaarle.
how.s2d: Standard or Advanced — the AI analyzes your product and chooses the style, backdrop and colors itself. The tier only determines how rich the result is.
how.s3d: Get your poster, story and sales copy in one click. Download or share directly.

home.titleAccent: and get seen on Jaarle Market.
home.lead: Put your products online in minutes. Jaarle makes your posters, helps you share them on WhatsApp and social media, and shows your products on Jaarle Market. Customers message you directly on WhatsApp.
home.reassure: Free to start · No bank card · Wave and Orange Money
home.stepsDesc: Three steps, from your phone. No website, designer or community manager needed.
home.step1d: Name, logo, WhatsApp number: your shop gets its link and QR code in 2 minutes. It's free.
home.step2d: One photo is enough: Jaarle suggests the name, description and category, and creates your posters.
home.step3d: Share your posters on WhatsApp and social media in one tap. Your products also appear on Jaarle Market, and customers message you on WhatsApp.
home.step4d: Visuals and texts adapted to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Story and WhatsApp Status.
home.step5d: Post in one tap, share your link everywhere, display your QR code in store.
home.step6d: Customers see your products and message you directly to order.
home.stepsThen: All of this for free. Go Pro whenever you want to do more.

home.featuresDesc: One app for your storefront, your visuals and your social media.

home.f4d: Shop visitors, WhatsApp clicks, calls, most viewed products: finally know what sells.
